PC-4: Guarantee Credit tops up weekly income to £227.10 (single) or £346.60 (couple); eligible if assessed income below threshold. Since couple, threshold £346.60. Assessed weekly income: need to calculate. Weekly income total £340.26 (F6). Savings ignored. So assessed income = £340.26. This is below £346.60, so eligible.

PC-5: Weekly Guarantee Credit amount is the difference between the threshold and assessed weekly income. Difference = £346.60 - £340.26 = £6.34 per week.
